structured.answer: According to the page, I'd open the account at Pesagot and buy the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". With 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for ten years, that would come to about 86,492 ₪. But Pesagot isn't my bank and I don't understand half the words, so I won't do anything before I ask you, my son.

stuck.why: "להשקיע במדד": to me מדד is the price index from the news, so at first I didn't understand what this was about at all

stuck.where: Screen 1, the box next to the big number
stuck.why: "86,449 ₪" with "−43 ₪" in red. I didn't understand whether that's a loss or a difference, and it frightened me
Pesagot is first, but I don't know it the way I know Leumi or Hapoalim. Leumi gives 83,396 and I wasn't sure whether it's worth paying a bit more to be at a bank I know
"−1,268", "−3,671", "−23,766". So much red that I wanted to close the page
That's exactly like the fund that fell on me back then. That's where I stopped

used: The boxes on screen 1: סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500, 10 שנים, 7%
The big number 86,492 ₪ with "הבחירה שלכם · הזול"
The right-hand list on screen 2: Pesagot 86,492 at the top, Leumi 83,396
The fund name at the top of the left-hand list: ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) 5139282
skimmed: The colourful labels under each fund
The list of banks further down (הבינלאומי, מסד, הפועלים, יהב, ירושלים, דיסקונט)
The red minus column on the left side
skipped: The English funds: iShares, Vanguard, IE00...
The explanatory paragraph "למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות"
Screens 7-10, which I didn't get to
unsure_meaning: the dotted underline under the numbers
not_found: Whether this is safe like a deposit, or whether I could lose
Whether my own bank is in the list and what it charges me
A simple sentence saying what to do, step by step
Who is behind the site: "מקור" doesn't tell me anything

findings.what: Lots of red minuses all down the page. They look like losses, even though they're probably only a difference compared with the cheapest
"−21.8% ב־2022" in large text with no sentence about what it means for me
No word anywhere saying the money can go down. The 7% looks like a promise
The page opens with "מדד" and English letters. For someone like me, that's a reason to leave straight away
Words I don't understand (צוברת, נאמן, דמי משמרת, מנוטרל מט"ח) with no simple explanation next to them
Dark background with small coloured text. Hard to read the labels and the grey lines even enlarged
Funds with long English names and codes
A chart with four lines in close colours that I couldn't tell apart
Sliders under every box. Luckily I could type a number
